title: "زنداں چہ موسیٰ کاظمؑ دی رات آخری اے"

Zindaan Ch Musa Kazim Di Raat Akhri Hai
Bay Jurm Chodah Saal Di,  Aj Qaid Muk Gayee Ay

1
Aida Howay Koi Waris
Jera Aa Janaza Chaway
Be Varisanday Wangun
Aidi Laash Pull Tey Pai Ay

2
Mango Duwain Jag Tey
Enjh Da Na Qaidi Howay
Jeidi Peerh Tey Jawani
Qaidan Chay Rul Gai Ay

3
Vasday Shaihir Janaza
Mazdooran Nay Hai Chaya
Gurbat Di Aaj Ay Maula
Ho Inteha Gai Ay

4
Maiyat Nu Chad Kay Tur Gay
Na Bayriyan Lahaiyan
Baqiyan Cho Akay Zahra
Maiyat Tey Rondi Rai Ay

5
Mumtaz Likh Kay Nauha
Maula E Moosa Kazim
Ronda Kalam Ay Mera
Tehreer Rondi Paiye

item.text:
Reconstructed the [selected lyric](src/data/lyrics/zindan-chh-mosi-kazm-di-rat-aakhri-ae.md) in Shahmukhi Punjabi and preserved the Roman wording in `romanLyrics`. The grammar across the verses supports Punjabi, so I updated the language metadata and removed the missing-source tag.

Verified that the two opening verses and all five four-verse stanzas align. I read the ambiguous Roman `peerh` as `پیڑ` and `Baqiyan` as a reference to `بقیع`.
